a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan means we'd need two generator rounds before taking. That gives about a 4% chance either of us survives. So I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than doing it quietly. If we both take, the split is random and we could both end up short. If you have a better idea, tell me. Otherwise, after I'm safe I'll operate or give back anything extra to help you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
